title: Prevention of Corruption N -W F P Amendment Ordinance 1997

sections.shortTitle: Prevention of Corruption N -W F P Amendment Ordinance 1997
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION (NORTH﷓WEST FRONTIER PROVINCE)
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION (NORTH‑WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 27th January, 1997]
No Legis. 1(12)/96/576.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province
is hereby published for general information:
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 (Act II of 1947). for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial
Assembly is not in session and the Governor of the North‑West Frontier
Province is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to
take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of the North‑West Frontier
Province is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the Prevention
of Corruption (North‑West Frontier province) (Amendment) Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 5 of Act II of 1947

PREVENTION OF CORRUPTION (NORTH‑WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE) (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to amend the
Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 27th January, 1997]
No Legis. 1(12)/96/576.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province
is hereby published for general information:
Whereas it is expedient further
to amend the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 (Act II of 1947). for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
And whereas the Provincial
Assembly is not in session and the Governor of the North‑West Frontier
Province is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to
take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of the North‑West Frontier
Province is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 5 of
Act II of 1947,‑‑In the Prevention of Corruption Act, 1947 (Act
II of 1947), in its application to the North‑West Frontier Province, in
section 5, in subsection (1), after clause (a) the following new clause shall
be inserted, namely:
"(aa) if he
does or forbears to do any official act or shows or forbears to show, in the
exercise of his official functions, favour or disfavour to any person or
renders or attempts to render any service or disservice to any person, in
violation or contravention of any provision of any law for the time being in
force, or of rules made under Article 119 or 139 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, or the North -West Frontier Province Civil
Servants Act, 1973 or any other law for the time being in force, including the
North‑Vest Frontier Province Government Rules of Business, 1985, in a
manner which may appear to facilitate acceptance or obtaining or agreeing to
accept or attempting to obtain from any person for himself or for other person
any gratification, whatsoever, other than the legal remuneration, as a motive
or reward, or".
